name: grid-masonry
description: Private npm workspace for deterministic grid-masonry Core, React Web, and Browser packages.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=grid-masonry-core && npm run build --workspace=grid-masonry-react && npm run build --workspace=grid-masonry-browser
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=grid-masonry-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=grid-masonry-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=grid-masonry-react && npm run typecheck --workspace=grid-masonry-browser
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=grid-masonry-core && npm run test --workspace=grid-masonry-react && npm run test --workspace=grid-masonry-browser
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
